title: research.brief
description: Search Semantic Scholar for a query and synthesize a multi-paper research brief with Claude: sectioned prose with inline citations into the returned paper list. ONE language-model call per query. The brief is persisted so research.recent can recall it without re-synthesizing. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the node; without it (or on a search / synthesis failure) the surface denies cleanly rather than returning a half-rendered brief.

query.description: Free-text research query — what to read the literature on. Example: user asks 'what does the literature say on retrieval-augmented generation' → pass 'retrieval-augmented generation'.
